name: python-language-plumbing
body: Add a `py` language id and wire it into the scan plumbing exactly as the other frontends: (a) the auto-detection candidate list — add a `py` candidate with .py/.pyi to auto_detect_languages (src/main.rs) so a Python repo selects the frontend; (b) the available_languages() probe — a candidate fires only when present in the installed-frontend list, so available_languages() (src/main.rs) must probe the pyfrontend artifact alongside the existing frontend probes; (c) the lang_switch control record that drives per-record code-type classification and FQN rendering; (d) the --id-prefix namespacing entry (id_prefix_for) so merged multi-language scans keep opaque ids unique; (e) the runtime frontend-command resolution (frontend_cmd) for the pyfrontend binary, plus the APG_FRONTEND_PY baked-path arm and the help/error text naming the py frontend. Directory exclusions during auto-detection are the scan-exclusion rule (domain.constraint.python-exclusions), not the minimal hidden-entry/target/node_modules skip alone, so a tree whose only Python lives under an excluded dependency dir does not trigger the frontend. AC: a Python-only repo auto-detects py; a mixed repo scans py alongside its code languages into one graph; the py stream carries its own id prefix and lang_switch record.
